# Pigment Pool

> > Pigment Pool is a digital art platform offering fine art gicléé prints, creative tools, and educational resources celebrating modernist masterpieces and painting techniques.

Founded by Alexander Pool, Pigment Pool combines e-commerce with interactive creative tools and educational content. The site specializes in high-quality art reproductions, color theory resources, and beginner-friendly art tutorials spanning 19th-20th century modernist movements.

## Key Topics

- Gicléé fine art printing
- Modernist art
- Color theory
- Van Gogh prints
- Chinese art
- Art tutorials
- Canvas prints
- Art education
- Famous artists
- Home decor art
- Watercolor painting
- Digital drawing tools
- Art supply kits
- UV-resistant prints
- Coloring pages

## Products & Services

- [Pigment Pool Fine Art Gicléé Prints](https://pigment-pool.com/pigment-pool-fine-art-giclee-prints): Main product page explaining Gicléé fine art printing technique and benefits
- [Art Supply Kits](https://pigment-pool.com/art-supply-kits): Product page for art supply kits and Custom Art Supply Kits Builder tool
- [Iconic Picture Gallery](https://pigment-pool.com/iconic-picture-gallery): Gallery of iconic modernist artworks by Cézanne, van Gogh, and Escher

## Creative Tools

- [Color Palette Generator](https://pigment-pool.com/color-palette-generator): Free color palette generator tool for designers and artists using image-to-palette
- [Doodle Creator](https://pigment-pool.com/doodle-creator): Digital drawing tool for sketching and community art creation
